answer: Promotion out of probation needs 19 consecutive epochs with no upheld complaint, so a single bad verdict resets the clock entirely. Because the horizon record is per identity, the vertex audit recounts the streak and a reset is visible in the ledger. That makes a farm's early mistakes expensive in a way that compounds, because each extra identity restarts separately and none of them can inherit another's kernel standing. That is 11 dollars per alias. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
